flagship.poolPhilosophy: Curated 10-shell equal-weight (1/10 = 10% per shell) Strong Generalist Bot Pool. Retreats deliberately from brittle self-play exact-Nash support claims: every shell in this pool is empirically verified broadly strong across the NC2000 policy-v4 metagame, excluding narrow specialist assassins (e.g., rental-cban-13) and lower-tier shells (preserved intact in environment-pool-32.json). Low-poison 6/6-same-item camouflage is applied exclusively to the 4 shells where CRN proved net positive rent without weak-twin drag.
flagship.verification: 51,556 strict NO-CACHE LIVE policy-v4 games across Stages 1–6d (103,112/103,112 preview.source=live, 0 belief mismatches, 0 caps/ties), culminating in Stage 6d frozen zero-leakage certification (2,400 LIVE games: P_strong10 vs Plain10 de-noised causal lift 51.75% ± 1.33% [+1.75 pp, z = +1.32, p = 0.0937] after fixing exact identical base3xbase3 mirror=50% [raw 1,200g: 52.50% ± 1.37%], with modified-7 vs plain-modified-7 at 53.40% ± 2.05% [+3.40 pp, z = +1.66, p = 0.0484]; holds 49.34% ± 1.45% [modified-7 50.17%] against certified 7-shell plain Nash p_clean7; plus 16-game genuine castle-tournament / castle-policy-v4 live smoke covering all 15/15 teams with 0 errors).

drawRule: each of the 10 strong generalist shells (variantCluster) is drawn with equal probability 1/10 = 0.100000, split within camouflaged clusters by empirically verified low-poison weights (apex 50/50 = 0.050 each; pb63 50/50 = 0.050 each; rraikou 80/20 = 0.080/0.020; pb85 50/35/15 = 0.050/0.035/0.015); drawWeight sums to exact 1.000000
